layout: 宪法/; 法律/<名称>/ (Chinese titles without 中华人民共和国); files 第NNN条.md, 第NNN条之K.md, 序言.md, 目录.md, 附件N.md
note: Before the layout commit each act was a pinyin folder at the top of the repository (xianfa/ for the Constitution), with files art-NNN.md (art-NNN-K.md for 之K), xuyan.md, mulu.md and fujian-N.md. paths maps every old folder to its new one, files every old file to its new path. No text changed: every file keeps its blob, so git log --follow and git blame follow it. Tags and commits before the move keep the old paths.
